message.content: {"summary":"Your ZYZZsat concept is coherent and well organised, with STK evidence and hand calculations across all major requirements. The main limits are technical slips in the orbit and EOL sections, missing software files, unlabelled figures and weak referencing. Fixing these would move the design and presentation criteria from Adequate toward Accomplished.","criteria":{"C1":"Strong introduction: mission purpose, rationale, single-spacecraft justification and users are all covered with references. To reach the top of Accomplished, sharpen the operator/customer ownership and funding arrangements so the user chain is unambiguous.","C2":"All major requirements are covered with STK screenshots and hand calculations, but several errors hold this at Adequate. Correct the resolution logic in Orbit, justify or remove the RAAN 27.33° claim, address the Vega E schedule risk, complete the truncated EOL drag-sail analysis with area/altitude/deorbit time, add explicit manoeuvre analysis, fix the duplicate row 15 in the access table, and include the software files.","C3":"Conclusions restate each segment and note the launch risk, but are not yet evidence-driven. To reach Accomplished, synthesise the key findings (orbit, contact cadence, EOL outcome) into specific conclusions tied to your results, including the drag-sail disposal outcome.","C4":"Structure, headings and executive summary are clear and the writing is readable. To reach Accomplished, add numbered captions to all figures and tables, replace Wikipedia and bare URLs with proper citations, and clean the reference list so in-text citations match it exactly."},"next_steps":["Revise the Orbit section: correct the resolution-versus-altitude statement, derive or remove the RAAN 27.33° launch-site claim, and add an explicit injection manoeuvre analysis.","Complete the Mission Duration & EOL section with a drag-sail area, altitude and deorbit-time calculation, and conclude the EOL outcome in the Conclusion.","Improve presentation: number all figure/table captions, include the STK/software files, and replace Wikipedia and bare-URL references with properly formatted citations that match the in-text list."]}
